signal_or_failure: Gross margin negative on its only product year
what_it_demonstrated: that the first commercial attempt lost money on every unit sold at the reported level
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: whether the cause was price, yield, or inventory write-down - none is printed
notes: candidate component of the 1997 restatement question; kept as a question

signal_or_failure: First product discontinued and second product cancelled
magnitude: NV1 sales stopped; NV2 development ceased
what_it_demonstrated: that the company's founding architectural bet failed inside three years of shipping
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: that the founders were right to change course, and when the change was decided; the filing's own causal sentence puts adoption after the withdrawal

signal_or_failure: Manufacturing failure at the sole supplier
what_it_demonstrated: that the company's whole supply position was single-threaded at the moment it first earned money
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: the dollar cost, which is not printed
notes: the only incurred operational failure inside the window

what_it_demonstrated: extreme dependence on two buyers on purchase orders rather than contracts
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: that those buyers were secure, or that the concentration was not about to change (the FY1999 mix is (PB))
notes: both percentages are the company's own disclosure for calendar 1997; no customer-side confirmation of either figure is held anywhere in the corpus

magnitude: Series D at $5.26 vs Series C at $6.67
what_it_demonstrated: that at least one 1997 financing cleared below the 1995 price
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: why, and whether more was sought than obtained
notes: the single most useful filed datum against reading the middle years as inevitable

signal_or_failure: The founding product was withdrawn and the second cancelled inside the stage
magnitude: revenue of 3,912 thousand in 1996 came from a product already stopped in Q1
what_it_demonstrated: that the architecture bet failed on the company's own account
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: that the failure was useful: the filing's own causal sentence places API adoption after the withdrawal (part 1 P1K03)
notes: Extended here: all 1995 and 1996 revenue was sale AND licence of that same product

signal_or_failure: First of three competitor patent suits notified
magnitude: one patent, treble damages and an injunction sought
what_it_demonstrated: that the market the company entered in 1997 was policed by litigation
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: merit or outcome: UNKNOWN; the company's belief in its defences rests on a retained counsel's opinion

signal_or_failure: Third patent suit directed specifically at the newest product, RIVA TNT
what_it_demonstrated: that the re-architected product line drew infringement claims of its own
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: that infringement occurred. This is the failure class the pivot narrative omits, and it is filed by the company itself
notes: Answers and invalidity counter-claims filed in each suit

signal_or_failure: Negative gross margin quarter at the new fabricator: cost of revenue 12,961 on revenue 12,134
magnitude: gross loss 827 and net loss 9,652 thousand
what_it_demonstrated: that the manufacturing switch carried a quantified cost within the stage
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: root cause: the company attributes it to yield problems and inability to supply in a timely way, and no further. TSMC, the design or the schedule is not distinguished
evidence_class: CONTEMPORANEOUS, unaudited quarterly data, self-disclosed cause
notes: The largest single-period loss in the corpus. The same quarter is dated July 28 in a risk factor (U.104)

signal_or_failure: Receivable allowance rose to 3,506 thousand while three customers held all accounts receivable
what_it_demonstrated: that concentration had begun to be priced into the accounts
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: that any amount was written off; the company reported no bad debt write-offs through 1997
evidence_class: FACT as printed, with a three-date allowance caption against four columns
notes: The allowance caption does not map cleanly to the balance sheet columns; recorded as a basis caveat

signal_or_failure: The largest customer is being acquired by a patent plaintiff, and the company says so
magnitude: 63 percent of 1997 revenue; 40 percent in the last nine months
what_it_demonstrated: that the registrant disclosed a channel loss before it happened rather than after
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: that it could be avoided: no mitigation is printed beyond finding other buyers
notes: Completion and date of the acquisition are UNKNOWN from held bytes (U.111)
